mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last two months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate revenues and earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output and potential supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (less than 0.2% increase), it signals a strengthening demand without significant inflationary pressure, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% MoM and CPIAUCSL increase < 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% MoM and CPIAUCSL increased by less than 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals an environment of high interest rates and rising inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 5% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) decreases by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month, it signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decrease > 0.5% QoQ and UNRATE increase > 0.3pp MoM
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 decreased by more than 0.5% QoQ and UNRATE increased by more than 0.3pp MoM.
